name: oya-application-shell-frontend-prototype

stack.cargo_leptos_config: Cargo.toml#[package.metadata.leptos] metadata only; not CI/CD/build authority
stack.hydration_model: SSR-first static shell with selective Leptos/WASM island mounting; Workflow, Messenger, Mail, and Community interactions keep local visual state and fetch permitted render envelopes when context changes.
stack.island_entrypoint: mount_dashboard_islands() exported from the WASM package
stack.dev_server_fallback: The documented Buck2 SSR dev server attempts the WASM island bundle first, then loads /client/prototype-interactions.js so the prototype remains visually interactive without generated /pkg assets.

dev_commands.name: preferred local dev server
dev_commands.notes: Uses the Buck2 rust_binary for the mock-only local shell at 127.0.0.1:3000; cargo-leptos metadata remains descriptive only.

dev_commands.name: documented local dev server without cargo-leptos
dev_commands.notes: Launches the crate-local SSR mock shell server through Buck2 and serves /api/render-envelope/<context-id> for selective island refreshes.

dev_commands.name: documented build equivalent when cargo-leptos is not installed
dev_commands.notes: Builds the Leptos/WASM scaffold surfaces through Buck2 without launching a dev server.

non_goals: no PHI, PII, or production tenant data
no healthcare, financial, legal, or operational action

rendering_security.task_1_scope: superseded by user expansion to full dashboard after scaffold acceptance

implemented_files.hydrated_state: src/client_session_state.rs stores active permitted context/session state only
implemented_files.server_endpoint: src/main.rs serves /api/render-envelope/<context-id> only in the SSR dev server
implemented_files.wasm_island: src/app.rs DashboardIsland fetches one permitted envelope at a time and does not embed the full server mock catalog
implemented_files.surface_interactions: src/app.rs ProductSurface, WorkflowTool, Work Hub composer, and Workflow Studio local draft-node state
implemented_files.visual_fallback: static/prototype-interactions.js provides the same visual-only local interactions when generated WASM assets are not present in the dev server package directory.

rendering_security.context_switching: Context buttons are inside a selective Leptos/WASM island. The browser requests /api/render-envelope/<context-id>; the SSR/server-only mock catalog derives and serializes only the permitted TenantRenderEnvelope for that tenant/role/accreditation context.

selective_wasm_islands.ssr_shell: Header, hero, prototype notice, and initial dashboard HTML are server-rendered and useful before WASM loads.
interactive_scope: workflow node inspection, mode switching, visual block insertion, and simulation preview
Messenger channel switching, item inspection, and local draft queueing
Mail compose preview and local draft queueing
Community topic inspection and local post draft queueing
selective_wasm_islands.non_shipped_catalog_invariant: src/server_mock_catalog.rs and full mock catalog sentinel are compiled only with feature=ssr; browser artifacts must not contain SERVER_ONLY_CATALOG_SENTINEL_DO_NOT_SHIP_TO_BROWSER_WASM.

rendering_security.interactive_but_unwired: Workflow block additions, mode switching, hub channel switching, item inspection, and draft queueing are functional in local WASM state only; no backend mutation, external send, or workflow execution occurs.

forbidden_fallbacks: client-side hiding of unauthorized modules as a security model
implemented_surfaces: cohesive mock Workflow Studio with palette, canvas, inspector, mode toolbar, local visual block insertion, and simulation preview
built-in Messenger with local thread selection and draft queueing
built-in Mail with local compose/draft queueing
built-in Community spaces with local post draft queueing

visual_reference.workflow_dashboard_reference: Visual Ralph full dashboard reference generated with imagegen and copied into the workspace
visual_reference.integration_note: References informed layout density, palette/canvas/inspector/status composition, and neutral token direction; React/JSX was not ported.
